Elements and Qualities

Olivia · Aspects

    Henry · Aspects

      An honest note about these charts. No birth times were given, so both charts were calculated for noon, Yangon time, with the birthplace taken as Yangon. The Sun signs and planet positions are for the birth day and are solid. The Ascendant, MC, and house placements marked † are noon estimates, and exact houses need a birth time.

      * Olivia's Moon. At noon on 3 February 2003 her Moon was at 5°05 Pisces, but the Moon only entered Pisces at about 1:30 AM that day. If Olivia was born before then, her Moon is Aquarius instead. Send over both birth times any day and these charts can be made exact.
      the charts keep agreeing with each other

      Our Compatibility

      No invented scores and no star ratings, just the real placements in both charts, and how they meet.

      Four things the two charts genuinely share, read straight from their computed birth data.

      • Both Venus in Sagittarius. They love the same way: honestly, warmly, and always up for an adventure.
      • His Moon meets her Venus and Mars. Henry's Sagittarius Moon sits with Olivia's Venus and Mars in Sagittarius. He feels at home in her heart, and she feels it too.
      • Neighboring Suns. Capricorn and Aquarius sit side by side in the zodiac. Different flavors, same street.
      • Two near new moons. Hers 3.4% lit and waxing, his 4.9% lit and waning. Two fresh starts that found each other.
